shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json && git diff package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -50
cat app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json; echo ---; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs; echo ---; cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'

grep -n "export function cookies\|export function headers\|export declare function cookies\|export declare function headers\|export type UnsafeUnwrappedCookies" node_modules/next/dist/server/request/cookies.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/request/headers.d.ts

(npx next dev -p 3123 > /tmp/next-dev.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 40); do curl -s -o /dev/null http://localhost:3123/ && break; sleep 1; done
echo "--- no cookie, no header:"; curl -s http://localhost:3123/ -H 'Accept-Language:' | grep -o '<dd[^>]*>[^<]*</dd>'
echo "--- theme=dark, fr-CH,fr;q=0.9,en;q=0.8:"; curl -s http://localhost:3123/ -H 'Cookie: theme=dark' -H 'Accept-Language: fr-CH, fr;q=0.9, en;q=0.8' | grep -o '<dd[^>]*>[^<]*</dd>'
echo "--- q-ordering (de;q=0.5, ja;q=0.9):"; curl -s http://localhost:3123/ -H 'Accept-Language: de;q=0.5, ja;q=0.9' | grep -o '<dd[^>]*>[^<]*</dd>'
echo "--- wildcard only:"; curl -s http://localhost:3123/ -H 'Accept-Language: *' | grep -o '<dd[^>]*>[^<]*</dd>'
echo "--- empty theme cookie:"; curl -s http://localhost:3123/ -H 'Cookie: theme=' | grep -o '<dd[^>]*>[^<]*</dd>'
pkill -f "next dev -p 3123"; grep -i "error\|warn" /tmp/next-dev.log | head
